title: The Rise and Fall of the Small Truck in America (And the Rule That Killed It)
description:
For more than twenty years, Americans could walk into almost any dealer and buy a small, simple, cheap pickup truck. Then, almost overnight, they vanished. Not because people stopped wanting them, but because of a rule most buyers have never heard of. And in twenty twenty-six, more than one hundred eighty thousand people put down deposits on a small pickup that costs under twenty-five thousand dollars. The compact truck is trying to come back.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
